tasks.short: Recommend equipment to control dust, temperature or humidity.

steps.what: Read temperature and humidity at the system installation.
Recommend equipment to control temperature and humidity.
Draft the purchase note from figures the tester typed.

loop.input: the recommendation and the figures the tester typed
loop.output: a purchase note that quotes only those figures
loop.check: every amount must be one the tester typed; else discard
loop.stop: one draft; a missing price is left blank
loop.why_not_simpler: whether to buy is not this note

steps.what: Send the purchase recommendation to procurement.

tasks.design: The tester reads the room at the installation and recommends equipment. The purchase note may quote only figures they typed. Procurement receives the recommendation. Nothing is ordered from this task. Dust, temperature and humidity stay observations, not a catalogue match.
tasks.previous_blocker: The room was complained about with no reading, and the request had no figure.
tasks.enabler_now: A typed figure can be quoted. The right equipment for the room is not a lookup.
tasks.still_hard: A room whose dust or heat comes from a neighbouring process stays a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The tester has stood in the room and knows which reading matters for the machines.
tasks.altitude: The note takes less rewriting. The reading and the recommendation stay. No order leaves from here.

reach.task: See the recommendation and the figures
reach.learn: That this is not yet an order

evidence.claim: A note that quotes typed figures can be checked. Recommending equipment for a room cannot.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the tester reads and recommends. Procurement buys. Installing the equipment is facilities, not this task.
Structured input: location, temperature, humidity, dust note, figure the tester typed. Producer is the tester. An amount they did not type is discarded.
The visit and the recommendation stay. The note is not a vendor choice.
unknowns: Who may recommend a facilities purchase?
research_questions: How often is equipment requested with no reading?

already_counted.description: The recommendation is already the remaining time on that step.

approvals.approved_version: recommendation the tester wrote for that room

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the tester cannot visit the room, there is no reading and the recommendation should not be sent. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Store, retrieve and manipulate data for system analysis.

steps.what: Store test data against the system and the build.
Retrieve that data for the named question.
Manipulate the data into the counts asked for.
Read the analysis of system capabilities and requirements.

tasks.design: Test data is stored and retrieved on {DATA_PLATFORM} by system and build. Counts are made on {BI} for the question asked. The tester reads what those counts say about capabilities and requirements. The store does not write the conclusion.
tasks.previous_blocker: Results sat in run folders, and the same extract was rebuilt for each question.
tasks.enabler_now: Store, retrieve and a count are queries when the rows have a build and a system.
tasks.still_hard: A question the columns do not answer, and a requirement nobody wrote down, stay a reading.
tasks.human_edge: The tester knows which count answers the requirement and which count misleads.
tasks.altitude: Finding and counting the data take less rebuilding. The reading of capabilities and requirements stays.

reach.task: See the counts for their system
reach.learn: Which build the rows belong to

evidence.claim: Storing and counting rows with a build id is a query. Reading what they mean for a requirement is not.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the tester stores, retrieves, manipulates and reads. Historical narrative for a release meeting is a different task. Changing a requirement is not this task.
Structured input: system, build, check name, result. Producer is the test run. A row with no build is stored as unmatched and not counted.
The reading is remaining time. Counts do not fill a missing requirement.
unknowns: Do run outputs already have system and build?
Which questions are asked often enough to fix as counts?
research_questions: How long does a one-off extract take today?

already_counted.description: Reading the analysis is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Drop unmatched rows that cannot be tied to a build.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If runs do not name a build, the store fills with unmatched rows and the tester still reads by hand. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: A room reading and an equipment recommendation stay the tester's. Test data can be stored and counted. The reading of what the counts mean stays.
reach: Procurement sees figures the tester typed.
A developer can retrieve rows for one build.
skills_to_grow: Do not send a recommendation with no reading.
Do not treat a count as a requirement.
role.ambitious_version: An equipment note is not an order, and a row without a build is not counted.

job.title: Software Quality Assurance Analysts and Testers
